messages:
Maria (sec): Quick planning thread — we need to lock evidence collection windows for SOC2 fieldwork next month. Who's owning: audit-log ingest, KMS rotation proof, and HSM attestation slots? Also want a clear escalation path if an owner can't deliver by the cutover. TL;DR: owners + fallback + runbook link?
Sam (eng): I can take audit-log ingest (sam-eng). Plan: finalize ingest job + backfill. Target week of May 4. Need SRE for throttling/backfill schedule.
Kevin (ops): Kevin (ops) here — I'll own the KMS rotation proof artifacts and key provenance doc. Need staging keystore creds. Filing infra ticket: https://rwd.internal/infra/INF-4821 :spiral_note_pad:
Taylor (sre): Taylor (sre): I can schedule a smoke window for ingest and add the backfill cron. What's retention window for the logs we need to snapshot? Also cc @Oliver (audit) for evidence format.
Oliver (audit): Oliver (audit): preferred evidence payload: a daily manifest + checksums + S3 paths. No private key material. I'll drop a template in this thread.
Oliver (audit): ```
evidence_manifest.csv
# date, s3_path, file_count, md5_manifest_path
2026-05-05, s3://redwood-audit/2026-05-05/, 4321, s3://redwood-audit/2026-05-05/md5sums.txt
```
Maria (sec): Thanks. Proposed escalation path: owner -> their manager -> security lead (Maria) -> CISO oncall. If owner misses delivery window by >48h we trigger the escalation. Thoughts? :eyes:
Sam (eng): Sounds reasonable. For audit-log ingest I can add a healthcheck endpoint so we detect delayed backfill automatically. I'll add a Retry/Alert threshold.
Kevin (ops): +1 to escalation. For KMS artifacts, if staging access is blocked, fallback is to provide cryptographic attestation from HSM vendor + signed logs. I'll document steps in INF-4821.
Taylor (sre): I'll add SLO-based alerting to paging: if backfill backlog > 10GB and no progress in 2h -> page oncall.
Maria (sec): @audit-bot can we get a calendar invite to mark the evidence windows?
audit-bot: [automated] Fieldwork reminder: SOC2 fieldwork start 2026-05-05. Suggested evidence windows: 2026-05-04 through 2026-05-08. See /evidence-playbook.
Sam (eng): FYI — PR open: github.com/redwood/audit-ingest/pull/482 awaiting review from @Taylor (sre). Small config change and a migration.
Taylor (sre): I'll review PR #482 today. Also confirm I have access to the staging keystore to run the smoke.
Kevin (ops): Added Maria and @Taylor as watchers to INF-4821, assigned to kevin-ops.
Maria (sec): Can each owner post a single-liner status update here by EOD Friday so I can consolidate into the readiness doc? e.g., "audit-log: ingest PR + smoke scheduled for 5/3"
Sam (eng): audit-log: ingest PR opened, smoke scheduled 5/3, backfill script queued.
Kevin (ops): kms-rotation: artifacts templated, staging access requested in INF-4821, ETA 5/2.
Taylor (sre): sre: smoke window scheduled 5/3 02:00-04:00 UTC, will run backfill test on staging.
Oliver (audit): audit: template posted, will validate manifests within 24h of receipt.
Maria (sec): Perfect. If anything slips, escalate as outlined. Thanks everyone — I'll compile these into the readiness tracker and ping stakeholders. :thumbsup:
